title: Vojtas Main Conjecture on Height Inequalities in Diophantine Approximation
exact_target: Can unusually close rational approximation to a divisor be uniformly bounded by Vojta's height inequality outside a proper exceptional set?

sources.citation: Yasufuku, GCD inequalities inspired by Vojta's conjecture, Conjecture 8 (2024).
Lang-Vojta conjecture over function fields for very general log projective spaces.
